name: Expanded Home, scrolled phone record index
prompt: Use reference image 1's narrow portrait canvas, fonts, color roles and legible phone sizing, but replace its content with a scrolled viewport of the approved Home page. The image itself is a 390-by-900 CSS-pixel phone viewport, edge to edge with 16-pixel margins. It starts at Record book and an All records link. The site header and two large featured records have scrolled out of view; do not draw them, the profile content, a browser or device. Show four unboxed, full-width, vertically stacked list entries with quiet horizontal dividers. Each entry has category first, then holder, then result and date. Unluckiest season; Sample manager C; 3.0 wins below expected; 2022. Most productive pickup; Sample manager with Sample receiver; 169.4 starting points; 2024. Dropped players who delivered elsewhere; Sample manager F with Sample running back; 148.2 starting points elsewhere; 2024. Longest winning streak; Sample manager D; 11 games; 2021–2022. Each category is linked. Follow with Recent records and two compact unboxed entries: Sample tight end, 33.8 benched points, Week 12 · 2025; Sample manager E, 48.6-point winning margin, Week 10 · 2025. Keep normal text at least 16 pixels and let long names wrap. No four-column mini-table, repeated field labels, individual card boxes, side gutters, extra stories, avatars, calculations, status or update dates. All results are fictional.
